title: The Anatomy of the Advertising Budget Decision: How Analytics and Heuristics Drive Sales Performance
eligible_reason: Not a difference-in-differences or event-study paper; structural time-series model.
design_notes: Structural state-space model of brand advertising budgeting (baseline, adaptive experimentation, ad-to-sales ratio, competitive parity), estimated with a Kalman filter on monthly brand-level sales and advertising for eight brands in three categories (IRI and Nielsen scanner data, ad spend from Nielsen). 'Differences-in-differences' appears only in a literature remark on endogeneity strategies. No treatment, no adoption dates.
screener_notes: Not eligible: no DiD design. No replication package was listed in the batch file (package_dir and regressions_path empty); screening is from the article text only. Brand-level monthly data from IRI/Nielsen and advertising trackers (licensed).
